shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Cross-level combat, senses, NPC travel, CE bridge (experimental), "Traveler" transit animations with a real pre-hop delay, blueprint art, wall risers, Perspective Shift support. Workshop 3776015553, window 10 shipped. Window 11: §78 UNTESTED IN THE FIELD.

**NOTE TO SELF:** running spec, not a changelog. §0 handover; §1-19 architecture; §20 compat; §21-29 bug records; §30 SUPERSEDED by §62; §31 publishing + GIT; §32-40 records; §41-44 combat/senses/travel/CE; §45-50 field-report fixes; §51 Celestial Lighting; §52 field-report round 2; §53 arrival/landing; §54 structure fit; §55 exit grid; §56 Geological Landforms; §57 stale decoration window; §58 relocated-structure fog; §59 forbid-aware islands; §60 area-linear vanilla systems; §61 camera-mod coexistence; §62 utility COLUMN rework + §62.N; §63 stairs permission; §64 cross-level shadow depth; §65 forbidden mirroring; §66 aim/wild-miss/aim-pie; §67 boulder extrusion; §68 KCSG/VFEM2; §69 stair temperature; §70 band flora legality + §70.B (OPEN); §71 Smooth Terrain (RESOLVED; report awaiting paste); §72 link gizmos; §73 transit animations (SUPERSEDED by §78); §74 blueprint finished-art look; §75 wall risers (a-h); §76 Perspective Shift; §77 motion-study round 2 (CLOSED, Traveler picked) + §77b the railing bug + §77c art defects; **§78 TRAVELER + REAL PRE-HOP DELAY - BUILT, NOT YET FIELD-TESTED**. Keep every ⚠.

# As above, So below II (V2)

> V1 is DELETED from the tree (survives in git history pre-a50a744). ~118 .cs files, ~34,000 LOC. No em-dashes anywhere in shipped text.

# 0. START HERE

**CURRENT PHASE: WINDOW 11. §78 is written and compiles 0w/0e. IT HAS NOT BEEN RUN.**

**⚠⚠ THE NEXT ACTION IS A FIELD TEST OF §78, AND IT IS NOT OPTIONAL.** §78 re-introduces a pre-hop hold, which is the exact change that broke cross-level movement outright in run #297 ("can't command pawns across levels anymore"). The mechanism is different this time (see §78) but the blast radius is identical: if it is wrong, ALL cross-level movement stops working. Do not touch anything else until a colonist has been watched crossing a staircase, a grand staircase, a ladder and an elevator, in both directions.

Window 10 shipped §74/§75/§76 to Workshop 3776015553. Full checklist run; pushed as **`afaf614`**. `docs/UPDATE_NOTES.txt` holds the window-10 text.

**GIT:** `Astryls/As-above-So-below`, `main`, `afaf614` pushed. §78 is NOT committed.

**⚠ WORKSPACE DLL IS A DEBUG BUILD.** `build_mod` has no `-c Release` and `Source/ModSource.csproj` declares no Configuration. Rebuild Release before any publish.

**⚠ OWED, IN ORDER:** (1) **FIELD-TEST §78** (above). (2) **WORKSHOP SMOKE TEST** - subscribe-and-load from the WORKSHOP copy. Never yet done for any window. (3) **FINAL riser art** (Gemini PAUSED r5; ⚠ REWRITE kit prompts to the REAL palette - NO copper: power=steel+blue+hazard, pipe=pale+red valve, climate=ice+louver+orange, data=black+purple+cyan). (4) **FOREIGN PRINT-PATH AUDIT** (ledger 3). (5) **§77c ART** - the grand staircase east/west sprites are unrotated; user's domain. (6) §62.N formal line. (7) Smooth Terrain upstream paste. (8) §70 Caverns verify. (9) §78 cleanup: `IsGhosting`/`DrawGhosts` are retired stubs with two live call sites; delete once §78 is proven.

**⚠ SHIPPED KNOWINGLY UNVERIFIED (Workshop):** §62.N, §70 (w8); §62.M, §66c, §66e (w7). **⚠ SHIPPED WITH PLACEHOLDER ART:** the 12 riser PNGs, by explicit user decision.

**⚠ USER WORKING RULES:** (1) NEVER source design ideas from other mods unless asked - scans COMPAT ONLY. (2) Building art = USER via Nano Banana kits; render_svg_to_png otherwise = flat UI geometry only. (3) About.xml description = USER's copy. (4) N mockups = N CHOICES.

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: visual clarity from above, performance, vanilla parity.

**⚠⚠ THE FORTY-THREE RULES:** 1. CLAMP AT SELECTION. 2. NEVER PATCH `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms`. 3. REGION CONNECTIVITY IS MORE OPTIMISTIC THAN THE PATHFINDER: flood CELLS. 4. COUNT EMITTERS/POPULATIONS/ENGINE STACKS. 5 (§48): A `Touch` TARGET IS USUALLY UNWALKABLE. 6 (§49): A VANILLA HELPER CAN BE A NO-OP INSTEAD OF AN ERROR. 7 (§52): THE CARVE IS NOT THE LAST WORD. 8 (§52.6): A LOAD-TIME REPAIR PASS MUST NEVER RE-CREATE WHAT THE PLAYER DELIBERATELY REMOVED. 9 (§53): SOME MISPLACEMENTS ARE NOT VISIBLE IN THE CELL. 10 (§54): A STRUCTURE IS NOT A CELL. 11 (§55): A CELL-LEVEL VERDICT CANNOT AUTHORIZE A PAWN-LEVEL ACTION. 12 (§56a): A FOREIGN MOD'S MAP-SIZE SNAPSHOT IS AN INPUT YOU CAN CORRECT. 13 (§56g): NEVER COPY A GRID YOU DID NOT WATCH BEING WRITTEN. 14 (§56m): BEFORE RELOCATING DATA, ASK WHAT IS ALREADY AT THE DESTINATION. 15 (§57i): ASSERT ALWAYS, NARRATE ON REQUEST. 16 (§56o): COUNT THE FOREIGN MOD'S WRITE PATHS. 17 (§56q): A PASSING RUN THAT DID NOT REPRODUCE THE FAILURE IS NOT A FIX. 18 (§57a): NEVER EXONERATE A SUSPECT ON ONE CLEAN SAMPLE. 19 (§57f): `TicksGame` RESTARTS AT 0 EVERY NEW GAME. 20 (§57g): MOVING WORK EARLIER TURNS ON EVERY "IS THIS MAP READY" GATE. 21 (§58): THE PARALLEL GRIDS DO NOT TRAVEL WITH THE CONTENT. 22 (§59): A DERIVED GRID HAS NO PAWN IN IT. 23 (§60): AUDIT THE WEIGHTING, NOT THE SYMBOL. 24 (§61a): CLAMPING A VALUE WITHOUT CLAMPING ITS TARGET BUILDS AN OSCILLATOR. 25 (§61b): A POSTFIX ON `Update` IS AFTER THE OBJECT WAS ALREADY POSITIONED. 26 (§61f): EVERY READ OF THE MAP THE PLAYER CAN REACH MUST PASS THE RENDERER'S "IS IT DRAWN" GATE. 27 (§62c): PREFER SPAWN/DESPAWN OVER FLICK. 28 (§63a): A PERMANENT FICTION INSTALLED FOR ONE SUBSYSTEM IS READ AS FACT BY EVERY OTHER ONE. 29 (§0b): REPORT OUTCOMES, NOT INTENTIONS. 30 (§66d): A FELT DURATION IS A CHAIN, NOT A NUMBER. 31 (§66f): MAKE THE GUARD SAY WHICH CLAUSE DECLINED. 32 (§69a): TURNING OFF A TICK TURNS OFF EVERY SERVICE THAT RODE ON IT. 33 (§62k): A FILTER THAT CAN REJECT EVERYTHING MUST SAY SO. 34 (§62l): AN INVISIBLE THING IS ABSENT FROM EVERY SECTION LAYER; MESH AND OVERLAYS ARE SEPARATE METHODS. 35 (§62n): A CLONED FOREIGN DEF MADE VISIBLE IS IN NONE OF THE HOST'S OWN LOOKUPS. 36 (§70a): RUN VANILLA'S OWN LEGALITY PREDICATE. 37 (§71a): NAME THE ENFORCEMENT POINT BEFORE NAMING THE SYMPTOM. 38 (§73): WHEN A SPRITE MUST APPEAR AWAY FROM ITS THING'S POSITION, OWN THE DRAW. 39 (§76): WINNING THE LAST WRITE DOES NOT SETTLE A DISAGREEMENT ABOUT THE TARGET - SUSPEND THE OTHER DRIVER INSTEAD. 40 (§75.h): A TRIPWIRE THAT FIRES BEFORE THE OBSERVER ATTACHES IS NOT A TRIPWIRE. 41 (§77a): A STRUCT FIELD YOU NEVER SET IS A FEATURE YOU NEVER SHIPPED - `PawnDrawParms.facing` sat writable in a postfix we already owned while pawns walked backwards down the stairs. 42 (§77b): THE DIRECTION A MOTION READS AS IS A PROPERTY OF THE THING, NOT OF THE ARRIVAL - and the far end is a DIFFERENT thing with its own axis. 43 (§78): **DEFER THE MOVE, NEVER THE DECISION.** A delay that is safe and a delay that deadlocks look identical from the outside; what separates them is whether the deferred thing can decline to happen. #297 deferred the transit DECISION behind a cosmetic condition and deadlocked; §78 defers only the POSITION WRITE, behind a timer that has no way to say no.

# WINDOW 11 LEDGER

2. **⚠ WORKSHOP SMOKE TEST** of the window-10 upload.
3. **⚠ FOREIGN PRINT-PATH AUDIT.** §75.h proved the shape assumption wrong for a whole mod family. **RimIOT and Eccentric Tech have never been decompiled.** Rule 18: showing nothing across runs #330/#340/#346/#347 exonerates neither. Decompile each, find the print entry point, add a `Hosts` row if it is thing-side, PROVE it with `AB2: carrier probe`'s patch census.

# 1-30 — unchanged. # 31 PUBLISHING — docs/PUBLISH_CHECKLIST.md is authoritative; strip = SIX moves (Source, Tools, docs, .git, mockups, .gitignore) to a staging dir OUTSIDE `Mods/`; the utility pushes FILES + PREVIEW ONLY. # 32-72 — unchanged.

# 73. TRANSIT ANIMATIONS (V1 OF THE FEATURE) — SUPERSEDED BY §78

Kept only for the lesson. §73 shipped an INVERTED delay: the carry was instant and the latency landed afterwards, as a ghost redrawn at the origin mouth while the real pawn stood at the destination. It existed because run #297 had deadlocked on a pre-hop hold. Its costs - a ghost draw pass, a hide pose, a suppressed name label, and a knowingly-shipped lie where the pawn was hittable at the destination while drawn a band away - are all deleted by §78.

# 74. BLUEPRINT FINISHED-ART LOOK — SHIPPED w10, USER-VERIFIED

ABBlueprintLook static-ctor retint, Blueprint_ABBuild stuff tint, ABGhostGraphicForLinks IsDoor bypass. Single knob `ABBlueprintLook.BlueprintAlpha`, consumed in two places: the generated blueprint `GraphicData.color` and `Blueprint_ABBuild.DrawColor` (which must re-apply it on top of the stuff color, or a stuffed plan comes back opaque). **§74.b:** 0.70 read as ALREADY BUILT; dropped to **0.42**, below vanilla's own 0.6, because our art is full-colour where vanilla's is a desaturated wash. ⚠ NOT field-confirmed at the new value.

# 75. WALL RISERS — SHIPPED w10 (a-h), USER-VERIFIED, PLACEHOLDER ART

4 defs; a riser IS a `Building_ABColumn`; WallLamp attachment mechanics; no `holdsRoof`; cascade despawn with its wall. **f:** architect uiOrder links 2060-2066, columns 2070-2073, risers 2080-2083. **§75.g PROBE:** `AB2: carrier probe` - per-cell drawerType/IsCarrier/ShouldPrint census plus a live Harmony patch census. **Keep this tool.** **§75.h:** Dubwise layers derive from plain `SectionLayer`, declare NO `TakePrintFrom`, and print from `Building_Pipe.PrintForGrid` - so the old patch bound nothing and failed silently for two windows. Now patched per host, deduped by MethodInfo, with the prefix INSPECTING the `SectionLayer` argument so unrecognised layers print rather than hide (rule 34, fail-safe direction).

# 76. PERSPECTIVE SHIFT — SHIPPED w10, USER-VERIFIED

Suspend `Avatar.UpdateCamera` via a parameterless prefix while the viewed band is not the avatar's (rule 39). On transit, snap the camera and NULL `Avatar.physicsPosition`. Freeze via `State.CameraLockPosition`; `lockedByUs` guards release. Cross-band shooting and traversal needed no code: PS gates on `verb.CanHitTarget`, which funnels through our `TryFindShootLineFromTo` patch.

# 77. MOTION STUDY ROUND 2 — CLOSED. TRAVELER PICKED.

Five animation languages in `mockups/anim-A..E-*.html` over a shared kit; each covers all four link types on the REAL art with a 4-facing pawn, a scrubbable timeline, a Perspective Shift avatar view, gold/red footprint edge markers and a live C#-port panel. Machine-checked for NaN/range AND for railing crossings across 4 rotations x 2 directions x 61 samples. **User picked C - Traveler, watched at 0.30 playback**, and asked for the delay to be moved BEFORE the hop. A/B/D/E remain on disk as the rejected alternatives; D's structure-animation track (the building reacts) is the one idea worth revisiting later and is orthogonal to what shipped.

**⚠ §77a FACING (rule 41).** `PawnDrawParms.facing` is a writable `Rot4` on the struct our GetDrawParms postfix already takes by ref. Never set, so pawns kept whatever the pather left - usually south, i.e. walking backwards down the stairs. **⚠ ALPHA RE-CHECKED, STILL NO:** `tint` is writable but pawn materials are cutout; alpha needs `PawnRenderFlags.Invisible`, which routes every node through `InvisibilityMatPool.GetInvisibleMat` - a distortion shader with a hard-coded cyan multiply. A cloak, not a fade. Scale stays the only vanish channel.

**§77b THE RAILING BUG, BOTH ENDS.** Settled by decoding the PNGs, not by eye. Every `*_south` sprite has its notch on its **NORTH** edge (`AB_StairsDown_south` north-edge coverage 42% vs 88/99/87), shading light->dark toward the south. **Entry edge = `Opposite(Rotation)`, run direction = `Rotation.FacingCell`.** Near end: the old `near.Position - prePos` glide walked the pawn through the handrail on three approaches out of four. Far end: ⚠ **the counterpart shares this end's `Rotation` and that is a load-bearing invariant** (`GenAdj.AdjustForRotation` shifts even-sized footprints; `TryCellPairs` pairs cell i to cell i; the "stairs work sometimes" bug came from getting it wrong) - **DO NOT FLIP IT**. Same rotation ⇒ same notch side ⇒ a pawn surfacing there arrives at the DEEP end and exits along `-far.Rotation.FacingCell`, the reverse of how it walked in below. **Art is not centred in its footprint:** measured offsets now live in `ABStairAnim.ArtOffsets`.

**⚠ §77c ART DEFECTS - USER'S DOMAIN, NOT TOUCHED.** (a) `AB_GrandStairsDown/Up_east` and `_west` are the NORTH composition unrotated (1.85 x 2.43 cells), so a grand staircase placed east/west shows treads across the direction of travel. (b) `AB_StairsDown_east/_west` are a different composition from the north/south pair and sit 0.42 cells north. (c) `AB_StairsUp_east/_west` span the full 2 cells with no notch on any edge. (d) `AB_LadderUp_east` is a 0.14-cell sliver drawn 0.30 cells west of its own cell. `ABStairAnim.ArtOffsets` transcribes these honestly rather than correcting them; the mockups print a per-rotation ART warning.

# 78. TRAVELER + REAL PRE-HOP DELAY — BUILT, 0w/0e, ⚠ NEVER RUN

**The shape.** `ABWormholePather.Carry` now splits: `BeginCrossing` starts the hold, `TickCrossings` ages it, `CarryNow` does the position write and everything downstream. Both teleport sites (the tick sweep AND `TryConsumeArrival`) route through it, so which trigger fires first cannot change whether the clip plays.

**⚠⚠ WHY THIS IS NOT RUN #297 (rule 43).** #297 held the pawn by REFUSING AN ARRIVAL - it gated `TryConsumeArrival`/`ReadyToCarry`, so vanilla's `PatherArrived` never ran, the leg never completed, the job re-issued `StartPath`, `TrySegment` re-segmented, and the pawn re-arrived forever. **The transit DECISION was what got deferred, behind a cosmetic condition.** §78 defers only the POSITION WRITE: by the time `BeginCrossing` runs the record has already left `pending` and `everSegmented`, so there is no leg left to re-segment. The pawn is held by **`pather.StopDead()` + `StaggerFor`**, never by refusing an arrival. StopDead releases the path and clears `moving` WITHOUT notifying the JobDriver, so the waiting toil simply waits - no arrival fires at the stairwell, and because `moving` is false `PatherTick` never re-tests `AtDestinationPosition`, so there is no per-tick loop. On the arrival path returning true (suppressing vanilla's `PatherArrived`) is load-bearing and is safe ONLY because StopDead already ran.

**Every exit teleports or abandons.** Anchor lost mid-clip → `EndCurrentJob(Incompletable)` (⚠ required: the pawn is on a stopped pather under a PatherArrival toil, which is exactly `ABStuckWatchdog` episode B). Job changed → cancel with NO teleport (something else took command; yanking the pawn a level away would override the player). Pawn moved off its hold cell (stagger is aspirational) → fire early. `MaxHoldTicks` 300 backstops everything; `StuckTicks` is 180 but the longest hold is 78, so normal holds never trip the watchdog and a lost one does.

**What the delay buys back.** No ghost pass, no hide pose, no suppressed name label, and **the §73 lie is gone**: body and sprite agree on every tick, so a crossing pawn is no longer hittable at a destination it has not reached. The Traveler midpoint is now literal - the teleport happens on the frame the two halves match in scale and position, which is also when `ABBandView.FollowTransit` cuts the camera.

**Durations (`ABStairAnim`, the one knob).** Half-windows: stairs 40, grand 46, ladder 56, elevator 50 + 14/level capped 78. Total crossing 1.33 / 1.53 / 1.87 / 1.67-2.6 s. ⚠ **Chosen, not guessed, and one of two defensible readings:** the user approved Traveler at 0.30 playback, where both halves ran SIMULTANEOUSLY in one window; sequentially they cannot, so the approved window is split evenly. That preserves the felt length of the whole crossing at the cost of each half's curve running twice as fast as it did on screen. **If the motion reads hurried rather than the crossing reading long, DOUBLE these** - that is the other reading, and it costs 2.67s per staircase.

**Draw side.** `ClipPose` gains `facing`; `Patch_PawnRenderer_ABBelowShrink` writes `__result.facing` (never `pawn.Rotation`, so gameplay reads are untouched and it self-reverts). Entry forward = `near.Rotation.FacingCell`; emerge forward = `-far.Rotation.FacingCell`; `ArtOffsets` shifts the clip onto the drawn treads. `baseX/baseZ` carries the sprite from wherever the pawn actually stopped (within `ArriveRadius`, not necessarily the anchor) onto the link.

**⚠ RETIRED STUBS, NOT DELETED.** `IsGhosting` returns constant false and `DrawGhosts` is a no-op, both documented, because they have live call sites in `ABBelowDynamicDraw`. Delete once §78 is proven (ledger 11).

**⚠ STILL NOT DONE - ENTRY-SIDE PATHING.** Nothing forces a pawn to APPROACH from the entry edge: `PlaceWorker_ABLinkApproach` accepts any cardinal neighbour of any footprint cell and `TrySegment` rewrites to `near.Position` with no side preference; `LandingCell` prefers the anchor's own cell and then a random cell within `LandingRadius`. So the clip now always runs along the correct axis, but the pawn can still start or finish it standing beside the railing. The fix is `near.Position - near.Rotation.FacingCell * (size/2 + 1)` for the anchor and the mirror for the landing, **with a fallback to today's behaviour when that cell is blocked or unreachable** - a link must never become unusable (the ladder-to-nowhere class). Deliberately held back as its own reviewed change: it is a pathing behaviour change, where §78 so far is a draw-and-timing change.
